purpose: Physically validate the P8B/P8C provenance-bearing taskResourceContext path through normal agentLoop.runTask on the already validated real Pulsar UTF-8 selector use case. The caller supplies only an explicit current-document file resource. The product must derive the bounded P7E pulsar-document context, preserve semantic-first execution, verify the exact current-document surface before local visual perception, keep provider selection lazy, preserve CLICK_POSTED as delivery only, and require an independent post-action observation before VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
requiredClaims: the physical caller supplies taskResourceContext and does not supply visualFallbackContracts or visualFallbackCallerContext
the resource is one explicit absolute file with role current-document and application Pulsar
the effective visual source resolves as task-resource-context and derives the bounded pulsar-document caller context
the semantic planner remains ACTIVATE_APP Pulsar plus OPEN UTF-8 only and contains no resource path, caller context, scope, surface precondition, postcondition, provider identity or coordinates
the semantic OPEN attempt produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET before any visual provider selection
the exact current-document window-title surface precondition is materialized from the resource-owned path and verified before provider selection
the local macOS Vision text-region provider is selected exactly once after the eligible semantic gap
the visual target is exact UTF-8 and the action delivery state is CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false
VERIFIED_SUCCESS is produced only after an independent post-action observation verifies exact UTF-16 LE
the temporary document content hash remains unchanged and no encoding selection is confirmed
no screenshot bytes, OCR payloads, visual coordinates or external-network dependency are persisted by the test
pointer, modal, Pulsar process, Computer Control runtime and temporary files are cleaned up
P5A-P8C regression contracts remain passing and Computer Use/Computer Control product trees remain clean
nonClaims: This does not make the default interactive CLI a provenance owner; the CLI still invokes runTask(task) without taskResourceContext.
This does not infer document identity from window title, semantic snapshots, OCR, Vision, coordinates or planner output.
This does not promote generic Pulsar status-bar clicking or generic encoding-selector behavior.
This validates only the bounded Pulsar current-document UTF-8 selector path already physically established by P7C/P7E.
The postcondition UTF-16 LE proves the selector modal opened; it does not mean a UTF-16 LE encoding change was selected.
No mandatory network, account, cloud API or remote perception provider is introduced.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P8E identify or introduce a real deterministic product caller that owns taskResourceContext before runTask. The default CLI must not fabricate resources or infer them from UI state.

evidencePolicy.protectUserState: Pulsar must be closed before the session; otherwise the session BLOCKS before physical evidence creation.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact product or physical-fixture failure, fix forward without weakening semantic-first, exact surface matching, provider laziness or delivery != success, then create s02.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Use only a generated temporary document. Do not persist screenshot bytes, OCR payload, raw snapshots, coordinates or user document paths in evidence markers.
